banner.title: litellm-operator
banner.tagline: Renders the LiteLLM proxy from Git-declared CRs, and rejects any LiteLLM object it cannot validate.

explainer.title: Git declares the gateway, the operator renders it

steps.title: Install
steps.text: The OCIRepository pulls the litellm-operator chart. The HelmRelease installs its CRDs and one controller Deployment in ai.
steps.scene: a sealed package being unpacked onto a shelf

steps.title: Declare
steps.text: LiteLLMProxy, LiteLLMModel and LiteLLMVirtualKey objects in ai/litellm are the source of truth (file apply mode, store_model_in_db false). Admin UI edits are unverified.
steps.scene: blueprint cards stacked in a tray

steps.title: Render
steps.text: The operator writes config.yaml into a ConfigMap and rolls the LiteLLM proxy Deployment when the rendered file changes.
steps.scene: a gear turning a sheet into a config file

steps.title: Admit
steps.text: A failurePolicy Fail webhook checks every LiteLLM object at admission. With the operator down, the API server rejects them.
steps.scene: a checkpoint gate with a shield

steps.title: Stay quiet
steps.text: LLMKube auto-registration is off, so the operator never mints a LiteLLMModel that Git did not declare.
steps.scene: an empty slot with a no sign

art.about: a Kubernetes operator that renders a LLM gateway configuration from custom resources and gates admission
